title: Rough, Scratchy, Avoid
text: Rough, Scratchy, Avoid. Even after washing twice with extra fabric softener these felt like cheap, scratchy, denim. I picked these cases based on price. Someday I'll learn my lesson. Thankfully they'll only be used on the pillow at the foot of my bed that's there to keep my heels off the mattress. These are a far cry from the jersey sheets and pillow cases on the rest of my bed. I'd hoped they'd soften up with a couple of washes but they didn't and I'm stuck with them now. I won't buy these or this brand again.
